items.example: I need to weigh up my options before I decide.
items.exampleTr: Karar vermeden önce seçeneklerimi tartmam lazım.
items.simple: To think about the good and bad parts of something before choosing.

items.example: It's a long shot, but it might work.
items.exampleTr: Düşük ihtimal ama işe yarayabilir.
items.simple: Something that will probably not work, but you try anyway.

items.example: I'd play it safe and take the earlier train.
items.exampleTr: Ben garantiye oynar, erken trene binerdim.
items.simple: Do the careful thing so nothing goes wrong.

items.example: Stop sitting on the fence and pick a side.
items.exampleTr: Kararsız kalmayı bırak, bir taraf seç.
items.simple: You do not choose a side. You stay in the middle.

items.example: Let's go through the pros and cons first.
items.exampleTr: Önce artılarına ve eksilerine bakalım.
items.simple: The good things and the bad things about an idea.

items.example: Moving abroad was a huge gamble, but it paid off.
items.exampleTr: Yurt dışına taşınmak büyük bir risk oldu ama değdi.
items.simple: Doing something risky, when you do not know if it will work.

items.example: I'm in a real dilemma about which offer to take.
items.exampleTr: Hangi teklifi kabul edeceğim konusunda tam bir ikilemdeyim.
items.simple: A hard choice where both ways have a bad part.

items.example: I'm a bit hesitant about signing the contract.
items.exampleTr: Sözleşmeyi imzalamakta biraz tereddütlüyüm.
items.simple: Not sure yet, so you wait a little before you do it.

items.example: It was an impulsive decision, and I regret it.
items.exampleTr: Düşünmeden aldığım bir karardı ve pişmanım.
items.simple: Doing things fast without stopping to think first.

items.example: Driving that fast is just reckless.
items.exampleTr: O kadar hızlı sürmek tam bir pervasızlık.
items.simple: Doing something dangerous and not caring what might happen.

items.example: I'm cautious about lending money to friends.
items.exampleTr: Arkadaşlara borç vermekte temkinliyimdir.
items.simple: Careful, because you do not want anything bad to happen.

items.example: Overtaking on that road is a bit dicey.
items.exampleTr: O yolda sollama yapmak biraz riskli.
items.simple: Not safe. It could go wrong very easily.

items.example: Thanks for taking a chance on me.
items.exampleTr: Bana şans verdiğin için teşekkürler.
items.simple: You give someone a try, even though you are not sure about them.

items.example: There's no rule here, it's a judgement call.
items.exampleTr: Burada kural yok, bu bir takdir meselesi.
items.simple: There is no right answer. You must decide by thinking carefully.

items.en: err on the side of caution
items.example: When in doubt, err on the side of caution.
items.exampleTr: Şüphedeysen temkinli davran.
items.simple: If you are not sure, choose the safer way.

items.example: He weighed the odds and decided to stay.
items.exampleTr: İhtimalleri tarttı ve kalmaya karar verdi.
items.simple: You think about how likely good or bad things are.

items.example: It's time to cut our losses and move on.
items.exampleTr: Zararı kesip devam etme zamanı.
items.simple: Stop doing something that is losing money, before it gets worse.

items.example: Once you sign, there's no turning back.
items.exampleTr: İmzaladın mı geri dönüş yok.
items.simple: After you do this, you can never undo it.

items.example: It was a calculated risk, not a blind leap.
items.exampleTr: Kör atlayış değil, hesaplı bir riskti.
items.simple: A risk you took after thinking carefully about what could happen.

items.example: I made a snap decision and booked the flight.
items.exampleTr: Ani bir karar verip uçak bileti aldım.
items.simple: A choice you make very quickly, without much time to think.

items.example: Choosing between the two was a tough call.
items.exampleTr: İkisi arasında seçim yapmak zor bir karardı.
items.simple: A choice that is hard, because both ways seem good.

items.example: Quitting my job was a real leap of faith.
items.exampleTr: İşimden ayrılmak gerçekten büyük bir cesaret adımıydı.
items.simple: A big step you take even though you cannot be sure.

items.en: If I were you, I'd think twice about it.
items.tr: Senin yerinde olsam iki kere düşünürdüm.
items.example: If I were you, I'd think twice about it.
items.exampleTr: Senin yerinde olsam iki kere düşünürdüm.
items.simple: You tell a friend to be careful and think again before doing it.
